3_1_desc.en: Create Your Own Story With Park Cheomji And Turn It Into An E-Book.

3_2_dialogue.en: Let Me Show You How To Use It.

3_2_guide_1.en: Answer Park Cheomji’s Questions To Create Your Story.

3_2_guide_2.en: Your Own E-Book Will Be Created In A Moment.

3_8_dialogue.en: A Wonderful Story Is Being Created.

5_0_role_0_desc.ko: 꽹과리를 울려 놀이판을 여는 흥의 대장입니다.  걸쭉한 입담과 신명나는 장단으로 판을 이끕니다.
5_0_role_0_desc.en: He Is The Leader Of Excitement Who Opens The Performance By Striking The Kkwaenggwari.  He Leads The Stage With His Boisterous Banter And Exhilarating Rhythms.

5_0_role_1_desc.ko: 팔도 유람에 나선 거드름 가득한 양반입니다.  하인 말뚝이에게 번번이 골탕을 먹는 풍자의 주인공입니다.
5_0_role_1_desc.en: He Is A Haughty Nobleman Who Has Set Out To Tour The Eight Provinces.  He Is The Star Of The Satire Who Is Repeatedly Tricked By His Servant, Malttugi.

5_0_role_2_desc.ko: 힘꼴 좋고 흥이 넘치는 한량입니다.  판을 어지럽히는 먹중을 힘찬 춤 대결로 쫓아냅니다.
5_0_role_2_desc.en: He Is A Carefree Man Of Leisure With Great Strength And Overflowing Enthusiasm.  He Drives Away The Troublemaker Monk With A Vigorous Dance Duel.

5_1_desc.ko: 말뚝이와 함께 신명나는 춤을 추고 기념 사진도 촬영하세요
5_1_desc.en: Dance An Exciting Dance With Malttugi And Take A Commemorative Photo.

5_2_dialogue.en: I Will Tell You How To Use It.

5_2_guide_0.en: Select The Mask For The Role You Will Play.

5_2_guide_1.ko: 화면이 안내하는 동작을 장단에 맞춰 따라 추세요
5_2_guide_1.en: Follow The Movements Guided By The Screen To The Rhythm.

5_2_guide_2.en: The More Accurate Your Movements, The Higher Your Score Will Be.

5_2_guide_3.en: Check The Final Score And Malttugi's Comment.

5_4_dialogue.en: Who Would You Like To Be?

5_6_dialogue_0.en: If You've Had A Good Laugh, That's True Exhilaration!

5_6_dialogue_1.ko: 괜찮네, 탈춤은 놀다 보면 느는 법이지!
5_6_dialogue_1.en: That's Alright. You Get Better At Mask Dance The More You Play!

5_6_dialogue_2.ko: 흥은 넘치는데 몸이 반 박자 늦는구먼!
5_6_dialogue_2.en: You're Overflowing With Excitement, But Your Body Is Half A Beat Behind!

5_6_dialogue_3.en: Deongsil-Deongsil! Not Bad At All, Not Bad!

5_6_dialogue_4.en: Eolssu! You Are The Star Of The Show Today!
